tools.name: aitwire_entity_lookup
tools.description: Look up a business, brand, organization, person, or website's business-supplied entity record on AITWIRE by domain or name — its confirmed description, feed URLs, and proof counts, each carrying the date it was confirmed. Returns no match for entities that have not published to AITWIRE.

tools.name: aitwire_entity_feeds
tools.description: Page an entity's structured feeds on AITWIRE — products, services, articles or locations (tenant_id comes from aitwire_entity_lookup).

tools.name: aitwire_grounding
tools.description: Check whether a specific claim matches an entity's business-supplied record on AITWIRE. Returns verified / contradicted / unknown with a confidence score, so you can attribute the result.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "aitwire_entity_feeds" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Page an entity's structured feeds on AITWIRE — products, services, articles, locations, or policies (tenant_id comes from aitwire_entity_lookup)." → after: "Page an entity's structured feeds on AITWIRE — products, services, articles or locations (tenant_id comes from aitwire_entity_lookup)."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
